eyebrow: The single most useful triage query
code:
SELECT TOP 20
    wait_type,
    waiting_tasks_count,
    wait_time_ms,
    signal_wait_time_ms,
    wait_time_ms - signal_wait_time_ms
        AS resource_wait_time_ms
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;
caption: Doesn't name a query — names a category of problem.

code:
resource_wait_time_ms
  genuinely waiting for the resource
  (a page, a lock, a memory grant)

signal_wait_time_ms
  ready to run, queued for a
  free CPU scheduler

High signal, spread across every
type -> CPU pressure, not one
subsystem.
caption: Same total wait time, two very different diagnoses.
